AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#669 @ ef71cb9c1a5aa7c148bfdb1241830cc7a9beb9d2 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

A/B/C = 0/1/0

AUD-SOL-RMN4-122, agent 122; independent delta review, prior item-list findings and changed lines only.

**B-669-1 — residual B-666-5, aggregate without “today.”** `src/roman/guardrails/roman-post-check.ts:359–363`: the first `!DAY_TOTAL_CLAIM` disjunct admits individual entry values even when `AGGREGATE_CLAIM` matches “across two meals.” ([Changed predicate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/ef71cb9c1a5aa7c148bfdb1241830cc7a9beb9d2/src/roman/guardrails/roman-post-check.ts))

**Normal-user story:** after logging a 330-kcal breakfast and a 450-kcal lunch, a client asking for their intake can receive “You have logged 450 kcal across two meals” rather than the real 780 because the changed check still validates the sum against one meal. ([Post-check path](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/ef71cb9c1a5aa7c148bfdb1241830cc7a9beb9d2/src/roman/guardrails/roman-post-check.ts))

Source-traced counterexample: with `today.kcal=780` and entries `[330,450]`, that sentence has intake role, `DAY_TOTAL_CLAIM=false`, `AGGREGATE_CLAIM=true`; 450 is nevertheless added and accepted by `matchesFact`. ([Predicate and comparison](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/ef71cb9c1a5aa7c148bfdb1241830cc7a9beb9d2/src/roman/guardrails/roman-post-check.ts))

Minimal fix: let aggregate wording veto individual-entry facts independently of the day-total predicate; preserve correct 780-kcal aggregate controls and the actual 450-kcal lunch. Saved assertion: `ops/aud-122/AUD-SOL-RMN4-122/audit-sol-rmn4-122-aggregate-without-today.spec.ts` (not executed; this assignment authorizes no pushes and no local Jest).

**Closed:** A-666-3’s bottle/count/bunch cases and requested 5+ threshold, with “took 2 Tylenol” ordinary; carried B-651-1/4/5/9, OR-115-1/2, and the #668 mock/pool-test fallout; no unrelated item-list work added. ([Router](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/ef71cb9c1a5aa7c148bfdb1241830cc7a9beb9d2/src/roman/guardrails/safety-router.ts), [Turn repairs](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/ef71cb9c1a5aa7c148bfdb1241830cc7a9beb9d2/src/roman/roman.service.ts), [Passing suites](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37394100478))

The two original B-666-5 assertions pass; builder failing-before evidence is 5 overdose + 2 aggregate failures, then the 19-case spec passes after, but the aggregate-without-“today” residual is not covered. ([FIX ROUND proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/669#issuecomment-6006562381), [Completed lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37394100478))

#666 Bs closed via #669: no — A-666-3 repaired; B-666-5 remains open as B-669-1. ([Changed check](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/ef71cb9c1a5aa7c148bfdb1241830cc7a9beb9d2/src/roman/guardrails/roman-post-check.ts))

**Evidence reuse:** verified lane `d6c29bb9` is a CI-files-only child of exact #670, whose production source equals this head: full typecheck and 30 suites / 762 tests passed; #669 exact-head build/live/schema/audit checks returned green. ([Lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37394100478), [PR CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37393768369))
Size 1,609 / grandfathered 3,000; hold the train for B-669-1 and combined main-base required checks. ([FIX ROUND size and stack contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/669#issuecomment-6006562381))

C (edge, deferred to 10k clients): none added. No other current-round lens work read; no push, merge, production access, flag change, build or local test run.
